stateNote: If you are starting with fresh beets, boil them in water for 1.5–2 hours or roast at 350 °F for 90 minutes. When they are soft enough that a fork will go in easily then they are done. Put them in a sink or large bowl full of cool water. Once they are cool pick up a beet and press your thumbs into the skin to start peeling them; sometimes they are not soft enough for this and you just need to cook them longer. If you use canned beets they will be ready right out of the can.
